html:
SMTO-TSK-0038 — The Agent made a mistake updating its task plan

GUID: 235881c7-a96e-4b98-bd9a-b4dbf2d9965e
Slug: task-board-entry-invalid
Domain: TSK · Subsystem: tsk

What happened

  • While planning, the Agent tried to save a step that was missing a description or pointed at something that doesn't exist. Its plan wasn't changed, and the Agent usually fixes this itself.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Watch the task's activity for a moment; the Agent normally tries again and shows Updated tasks soon after. The Agent receives this message and can correct the step itself.
  2. If Task update failed appears again and again, select Stop, then send a message describing the steps you want in plain words. Clear instructions help the Agent build a plan SMTO accepts.
  3. If it keeps happening on different tasks, open Technical details in this panel and select Copy error details. The details show which part of the plan was rejected.

What success looks like

  • The task's activity shows Updated tasks and the work continues.

If it still fails

  • Send the copied error details to the person who manages SMTO. Don't try to edit or delete the task's saved data by hand; the earlier plan is still intact.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A manage_tasks board revision was rejected: an entry lacks an outcome description, uses an unknown status, sets waiting_job without a real job_id, or references a result outside the run's current or historical results.

What this means

  • A board task lacks an outcome description, uses an unsupported status, omits the job for waiting_job or cites a result absent from current/historical owned results. Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.

Why this can happen

  • A board task lacks an outcome description, uses an unsupported status, omits the job for waiting_job or cites a result absent from current/historical owned results.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the entry's fields with supported states and observed scoped job/result identities.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the manage_tasks call in the run trace: each upserted task needs a non-blank description, a status of pending, active, waiting_job, waiting_event, waiting_user, blocked, completed or cancelled, a real observed job_id for waiting_job, and references only to existing result IDs. The whole revision is rejected atomically; the model should resubmit a corrected revision.
  • Use a concise outcome description and supported status. Reference only observed jobs and exact results in the current task scope.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The board revision validates atomically with references that actually exist in its supported scope.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
